summary: A login managing two accounts: a read naming neither is refused, one naming the second answers its totals, and one naming an account not on the login is refused.

provenance.why: Nothing of the owner's account may be committed (the repository is public), so no account conversation is ever captured into it (ADR 0030).
provenance.built: Laid out as ibapi 9.81's decoder at server version 157 (decoder.py processPortfolioValueMsg; updateAccountValue, updateAccountTime, accountDownloadEnd and managedAccounts by their EWrapper signatures) and its reqAccountUpdates encoder, read on 2026-11-23. The managed accounts are one comma-separated field, as ibapi reads it.
provenance.invented: Every symbol, contract id, quantity, price, value, total, clock time and account id in this file is invented; the accounts are placeholders.
